logic.bar: UTC-aligned 4h close from 240 completed 1m spot bars; signal available at bar boundary.
logic.momentum: simple trailing return close[i]/close[i-L]-1 over exactly L completed 4h bars.
logic.entry: If flat, buy long when trailing return > configured entry threshold.
logic.exit: If long, exit to USDT when trailing return <= configured exit threshold; no shorting.
logic.sizing: Independent initial BTC/ETH sleeves of 1000 USDT each, raw weights 0.5/0.5; no transfers, leverage, normalization or cross-sleeve rebalance.
logic.execution: At signal availability, execute at next 1m open one minute after UTC 4h close; costed terminal liquidation.
logic.costs: 10bp taker fee/side, 1bp half-spread estimate/side, 2bp slippage/side, square-root impact from lagged 20d volatility and quote ADV, 0.1% ADV participation cap, 1x/2x/3x costs.
